result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, my recommendation would be **Stripe as your main payment processor, with PayPal offered as an additional payment option.**

However, the best choice depends on your website platform, sales volume and the types of customers you serve.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- UK domestic cards: approximately 1.5% + 20p.
- No monthly fee on standard pay-as-you-go pricing.
- Apple Pay, Google Pay and card payments.
- Excellent integrations with WooCommerce and other platforms.

[Stripe UK pricing](https://stripe.com/gb/pricing)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best additional option)

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers.
- Customers can pay using their PayPal balance or linked cards.
- Easy to integrate.
- Fees can be higher than standard card processing.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**

- Great for beginners.
- Particularly good if you also sell face-to-face.
- Online and physical payments in one system.

[Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

---

![Mollie pinautomaat kosten (2026) · gratis vergelijken](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D57_7d7oSy02s6yl1zjAav-Yxgf4LUZZPYDHYzFt_wNqCHlBqkrhAHplhYfBTJOJy91u1bEQYVbEZXh_gEzRP8VoyGIrNDZVtuNQGJCvwJQrSLcgSZ7d7a0ve45WpqW-VHK_GV5JgM8myiK1AujLCh4qHlURg2gBe2EoWYpui5Qphgo8QfSPgrRjtevRCmLH?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Mollie**

- Particularly attractive for European customers.
- Supports multiple payment methods.
- Competitive UK card pricing.

[Mollie website](https://www.mollie.com/)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Shopify Payments**

- Best if your store runs on Shopify.
- Integrated checkout and order management.
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

Indicative UK pricing checked against 2026 comparisons. Actual fees depend on card type, country, plan and payment method. [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/best-payment-gateway/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/gb/blog/best-startup-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[startups.co.uk](https://startups.co.uk/payment-processing/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I would choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| New small online store | Stripe |
| Shopify website | Shopify Payments |
| WooCommerce website | Stripe |
| Selling internationally | Stripe or Mollie |
| Online and physical shop | Square |
| Want customers to have more choice | Stripe + PayPal |


## A few questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the most cost-effective option rather than simply the most popular one.

**1\. What platform is your online store built on?**
